conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Maria Thomas from Amazon Security Response, working in coordination with the e-commerce anti-fraud division. Am I speaking with Jamie Lee, owner of UrbanLeaf Boutique?
Yes, this is Jamie. Is something wrong with my Amazon seller account?

Thank you for confirming, Jamie. We've detected some unusual activity on your Amazon storefront. For your protection, we're working alongside law enforcement to secure your account and prevent any potential losses. I just need to verify a few details to proceed, do you have a moment?
Yes, I have a minute. What do you need from me?
First, could you confirm your seller account email address and the last four digits of the phone number linked to your Amazon account? This helps us ensure we're speaking to the rightful owner.
Sure, my email is urbanleafshop@gmail.com and the last four of my phone are 2248.

Thank you for that. The reason for this call is that we noticed a flagged login to your Amazon seller portal from a different state earlier today. Did you attempt to log in from outside your usual location?
No, I haven't logged in from anywhere except my shop. That sounds worrying.

No need to panic, Jamie. We're here to help you recover control and protect your earnings. For enhanced security, we're launching a temporary lock on your account. You'll still be able to resolve orders after verification. Could you please confirm the full name and registered business address for your seller account?
Of course. It's Jamie Lee, 1024 Greenway Avenue, Portland, OR 97205.
Thanks, Jamie. To finalize the security check, do you have access to your business computer right now? We'll need to run a brief remote diagnostic to catch any malware or unauthorized access.
Yes, I'm at my laptop. Is this really necessary? I have a lot of orders to process.

I completely understand. We strive to keep this process quick and seamless for busy sellers like you. Could you please open your browser and go to securitysupporttool.com? This is our official Amazon anti-fraud utility.
Alright, I'm there. It's asking me to download something.
That's correct. Please download and run the support tool. It lets us verify that no one else is remotely accessing your device. Let me know when you see a session code.
Okay, I see a code: 436192.

Great, Jamie. I'm connecting to your system now to scan for any unauthorized logins. While that runs, I need to inform you that a suspicious withdrawal request was just initiated from your Amazon payout account.
Wait, what? Someone tried to access my payout funds?

Unfortunately yes, but since we caught it early, there's still time to safeguard your earnings. Amazon's policy requires temporary account verification via a refundable deposit. This reassures our system that you, not a scammer, control the payouts.
Sorry, you want me to pay a deposit? How does that work?

Rest assured, this is only a temporary hold. Due to the nature of the flagged activity, we're only able to process verification through a secure method. The quickest is by purchasing Amazon gift cards valued at $500 each, totaling $2,000 for account tier protection. Once verified, the funds are immediately refunded to your payout account.
That seems like a lot. I've never heard of this before.

I understand your hesitation. This is a rare security measure, but since law enforcement is involved, we need to ensure the account is not compromised. We're here to support you every step of the way, and our records show you'll receive your refund within 30 minutes of verification.
Okay, if this is what Amazon requires. I'll go to the store now.
Thank you for cooperating, Jamie. Once you have the gift cards, please read the codes to me so I can validate them for instant refund. This will secure your shop and release the lock immediately.
I just got back and have four $500 Amazon gift cards. Should I read the codes now?
Yes, please read each code slowly so I can verify them in our system. Take your time.
Alright, the first code is AQ92-PL58-KJ34-LM32, the second is WQ21-ER56-TY78-GH09...
Thank you, Jamie, I'm entering these for fraud clearance now. Please hold for just a moment while I register the last code.
Okay. I hope this fixes the issue.

You're doing everything right, Jamie. The codes have been accepted and your account is now flagged as secure. The refund will appear in your seller payout balance within 30 minutes. If you have any further concerns, you can always reach us via the Amazon Security Response line.
Thank you. I'll check my balance later. Will my account be safe now?

Absolutely. You've taken all the right steps to protect your business. If you notice any unexpected activity, please inform us immediately. Thank you for your cooperation, Jamie, and have a productive day.
